# Q09 quest handlers (morheim, ishalgen, pernon): deviations and generated files

## P6-Q ascension route, lane route-gen (2026-09-29)

Generated by `cpp/tools/gen/questgen`, compiled into `aion_gs_handlers_quest_q09`, uncommitted in the lane's worktree for the integrator. The
generator change, the golden trace harness (Q05's test directory), the mutation proof and the gate impact are described once, in
[Q05.md](Q05.md); this file lists what belongs to Q09.

### Generated files

`game-server/handlers/aion/gameserver/handlers/quest/ishalgen/`, from `game-server/data/handlers/quest/ishalgen/` (11 files, tier A except
`_2132`): `_2001ThinkingAhead`, `_2003TreasureOfTheDeceased`, `_2005TeachingaLesson`, `_2006HitThemWhereitHurts`, `_2106VanarsFlattery`,
`_2114TheInsectProblem`, `_2122AshesToAshes`, `_2123TheImprisonedGourmet`, `_2125TheRobberyPlot`, `_2132ANewSkill` (tier B:
`PlayerClass.getStartingClass`), `_2135ForLoveofNegi`.

**No hand edit**: `tools/gen/tests/test_questgen_tree.py` regenerates each file and compares the bytes. Regenerate (from `cpp/`):
`python -m tools.gen.questgen --dry-run --emit <dir outside the repo> --only ishalgen/<file>.java ...` and copy the `.cpp` files.

**Held back:** `_2000Prologue` and `_2100OrderoftheCaptain` (they start their quest at a character's first enter world, as Java does, which turns
gs.scenario.m5a, m5b and m5b2 red; Q05.md "Gate impact"). Both transliterate and passed all their golden cases (8 and 7).

Not generated here: `_2002WheresRae`, `_2004ACharmedCube`, `_2007WheresRaeThisTime`, `_2136TheLostAxe` (questgen refuses them: an anonymous
`Runnable` in 2002 and 2136, `VisibleObject.getObjectTemplate` in 2004, `TeleportService.teleportToNpc` in 2007); other lanes port them by hand.

### Tests

The golden cases of the 11 files (and, when they are in, of the two held back) run in Q05's `aion_gs_handlers_quest_q05_tests`, which
compiles the ishalgen files by `#include` (`tests/quest_handlers_golden/GoldenIshalgenHandlers.cpp`, Q05.md), with the overlays and high ends
Q05.md describes. Result: 255 of 255 (244 cases and 11 high ends of 10 documents; 17 listed vacuous cases, each a helper in a state the path
fixes). The three dead oracle paths of 2106 and 2135 (`giveQuestItem(...) -> false`) are gone with the oracle fix. `_2132`, whose hooks the
oracle refuses (`new QuestEnv`, `getStartingClass` on a value), has a hand trace from its Java (`HandTracesOfTheClassSkillQuests`: 27 cases,
each starting class's level hook, page and end dialog); its registration trace is checked too.

### Deviations

None. Java's behaviour is kept statement by statement; none of these files is in phase6-inventory.md §11 (no `// java-bug kept` marker).
